oracle: known exact factor families; SymPy symbolic real roots/signs; hand-derived quantifier reasons, independent of implementation

plane.name: circle equality
plane.reason: A circle exists, has no full vertical line, and has no point above x=2.

plane.name: closed disk
plane.reason: The disk has points but bounded vertical fibres and no fibre above x=2.

plane.name: open disk strict endpoints
plane.reason: At x=+-1 the strict disk fibre is empty; at x=0 it is nonempty.

plane.name: strict circle exterior
plane.reason: x=2 makes all y exterior; every x admits sufficiently large y; the centre is interior.

plane.name: parabola equality
plane.reason: The witness y=x^2 exists for every x, but no fibre is the full line.

plane.name: strict parabola epigraph
plane.reason: Choose y=x^2+1, while y=x^2 is a counterexample to universal y.

plane.name: quadratic degree birth
plane.reason: A real square equals x exactly when x>=0.

plane.name: nullified xy equality
plane.reason: x=0 nullifies the atom for all y, and y=0 works for every x.

plane.name: nullified xy strict
plane.reason: x=0 forbids strict positivity, and any nonzero x has both y signs.

plane.name: nullified xy disequality
plane.reason: At x=0 or y=0 the product is zero; x=y=1 is nonzero.

plane.name: guarded nullification
plane.reason: x=0 makes the guard true for all y; other x choose the matching y sign.

plane.name: shared line equality
plane.reason: y=x is a shared root for every x; other y refute universal y.

plane.name: shared root collision strict
plane.reason: The remaining root y=-x works exactly when x!=0.

plane.name: repeated square impossible
plane.reason: A real square is never strictly negative.

plane.name: repeated square nonnegative
plane.reason: Every real square is nonnegative.

plane.name: shared factors mixed strict
plane.reason: x=1 permits -1<y<1; x=0 makes y^3>0 and y(y+1)<0 incompatible.

plane.name: vertical leading coefficient
plane.reason: x=1 gives constant -1; other x have the unique root 1/(x-1).

plane.name: quadratic to linear degree drop
plane.reason: y=0 always works; at x=1 the polynomial is y rather than a quadratic.

plane.name: vertical nullification
plane.reason: The whole vertical line x=1 is zero and y=0 works elsewhere.

plane.name: irrational vertical nullification
plane.reason: x=+-sqrt(2) nullifies all y coefficients; y=0 works at every x.

plane.name: irrational nullification strict
plane.reason: The strict fibre is empty at +-sqrt(2), and nonempty elsewhere.

plane.name: vertical factor times horizontal square
plane.reason: At +-sqrt(2) all y work; choose |y|>=1 or |y|<=1 to match the other factor sign.

plane.name: pure base atom
plane.reason: At x=1 all y work; at x=0 none do.

plane.name: identically zero equality
plane.reason: The zero polynomial is zero on the whole plane.

plane.name: identically zero strict
plane.reason: The zero polynomial is never strictly positive.

plane.name: nonzero constant
plane.reason: The constant 3 is positive on the whole plane.

plane.name: circle shared line endpoints
plane.reason: Substitution y=x gives 2x^2=1, with exactly the two isolated solutions.

plane.name: circle line strict interior
plane.reason: Substitution y=x gives the strict interval -1/sqrt(2)<x<1/sqrt(2).

plane.name: open interval between moving roots
plane.reason: For every x, the open interval x<y<x+1 is nonempty and proper.

plane.name: closed interval between moving roots
plane.reason: For every x, the closed interval x<=y<=x+1 is nonempty and proper.

plane.name: contradictory strict and weak
plane.reason: A real number cannot be simultaneously negative and nonnegative.

plane.name: trichotomy tautology
plane.reason: Exactly one of negative, zero, positive holds at every point.

plane.name: empty true formula
plane.reason: A literal true formula holds at every point of the plane.

plane.name: empty false formula
plane.reason: A literal false formula has no satisfying point.

plane.name: negated closed disk
plane.reason: The negation of a closed disk is its strict exterior, including no boundary points.

relative.name: negative conjugate has no quadratic roots
